name: Question 1
problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with the following conditional probability density function:

$$
{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{2x}{{y}^{2}}, & \,0<x<y,\,0<y<1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Find $P(\frac{1}{4}<X<\frac{1}{2}\,|\,Y=\frac{5}{8}).$
worked_solution:
Recall that 

$$
P(X\in A\,|\,Y=y)={\int }_{A}{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x,
$$

where ${f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y)$ is the conditional probability density function of $X$ given $Y=y.$ 

In our case, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(\frac{1}{4}<X<\frac{1}{2}\,|\,Y=\frac{5}{8}) & ={\int }_{1/4}^{1/2}{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,y=\frac{5}{8})\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1/4}^{1/2}\frac{2x}{{(\frac{5}{8})}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{64}{25}{\int }_{1/4}^{1/2}2x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{64}{25}[{x}^{2}]_{1/4}^{1/2} \\  & =\frac{64}{25}(\frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{16}) \\  & =\frac{64}{25}(\frac{3}{16}) \\  & =\frac{12}{25}.\end{aligned}
$$
